title: centaurea scariosa proles heleniifolia
intro: Centaurea scariosa proles heleniifolia, commonly known as Mountain Bladder Campion, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea scariosa proles heleniifolia include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activities. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
